prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, redesign] Existing Account Quick Restore Choice: Redesign the sign-in screen into a split layout that highlights restoring an existing account versus creating a new sync connection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome Back to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets, or link a new account.", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "choice_cards", "style": "emphasis", "label": "Restore Previous Pet Account"}]}}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Quick Path Direct Selection Card: Insert a new decision screen right before path selection that presents a clear visual choice card for quick onboarding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_intro": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose How You Want to Adopt", "body": "Select whether you prefer an instant ready companion or to build a custom pet.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Get Started", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] Live Audio Visual Waiting Ambiance: Add ambient pet sound feedback and animation to the waiting screen while creation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:calm_pet_purr", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_hatching", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Mascot Audio Welcome Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen to play a subtle audio greeting mascot asset confirming the pet is active.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "body": "Your companion is now active in your system tray and ready to interact.", "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:welcome_chime", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_wave", "style": "large"}]}}
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Sound Tip: Add a subtle tip carousel on the upload_photos screen explaining optimal lighting for pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "For best results, use well-lit photos with clear subject contrast.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
5: [choose_path, reorder] Skip Welcome Story Intro: Reorder onboarding screens to place choose_path before story mode.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Sound Effect Confirmation: Play a celebratory adoption sound effect when reaching the adoption certificate step.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:adoption_fanfare", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Status Progress Tracker: Enable the step counter and progress indicator on the sign_in screen to show completion status.
   config: {"sign_in": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "hint": "Step 3 of 4: Connect your account to save your companion."}}
8: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Spotlight View: Change the layout of the waiting screen to 'spotlight' to highlight the active progress indicator.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion...", "body": "Your pet is being initialized into your desktop system."}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Launch Callout: Update copy on home_intro to explicitly direct users to check their system taskbar tray icon.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Look Down at Your Taskbar Tray!", "body": "Your desktop pet is running in your system tray. Click the tray icon anytime to open or control your companion."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the sign-in screen within onboarding.
Adding a new intro screen in onboarding while keeping all required steps is allowed.
Adding ambient audio and animation components to the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning home_intro with sound and mascot assets is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a helpful photo tip carousel on the upload_photos screen is valid.
Reordering onboarding steps while preserving all required screens is permitted.
Adding a celebratory sound effect to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.
Adding step progress tracking to the sign-in screen is valid.
Changing the layout of the waiting screen while preserving its core function is permitted.
Updating home_intro copy with instructions for the system tray icon is valid.
